runtime_binding.rule: Factory binds generated public operations to this fixture without rewriting Workbench assertions.

export_rules: Export only when this manifest status is semantic_closed.
Every declared source path must exist under the case directory.
Copy declared tests byte-for-byte; do not regenerate or normalize them.
Record SHA-256 of every copied source and target file in the Factory handoff manifest.
Fail export if a target semantic test exists with different bytes unless --update-existing is explicit.
Do not claim Factory execution success from Workbench export; runtime execution is verified only inside the local Factory environment.
